newsitem.title: USA: Trial of Orange County, Calif. auditor on hold.
newsitem.headline: Trial of Orange County, Calif. auditor on hold.

text.p: The trial of Orange County, Calif., Auditor Steven Lewis for alleged misconduct was put on hold after a court set a hearing to review his motion to recuse the District Attorney, attorneys said Friday.
The 4th District Court of Appeal issued an order seeking arguments from the Orange County District Attorney's office as to why Lewis' recusal motion should not be granted, attorneys for Lewis said.
Earlier this year, a Superior Court judge ruled that District Attorney Michael Capizzi has no conflict of interest and may continue to prosecute Lewis.
